title: Compatible-family module sheaf and its sectionwise universal property
statement: Let X be a ringed space, I any index type, U i an open cover, Fi i module sheaves on U i, and φij overlap isomorphisms (no diagonal or cocycle identities assumed). For an open V, a family assigns an element of Fi i(W) to every i and every W contained in U i and V. Call the family coherent if these elements respect restriction to smaller opens and φij identifies its i and j elements on every common subopen. There exist a global module sheaf H and morphisms πi : H.over (U i) → Fi i such that evaluating global sections through πi after restriction gives precisely all coherent families, uniquely, on every V. The section universe of H is max u v, independently of the universe of I. No local-isomorphism assertion is made.

proof.text: On V form the submodule of the product of Fi i(V ∩ U i) cut out by all overlap equations. Restriction is componentwise and respects these equations by naturality. Componentwise gluing and separation in Fi prove the sheaf axiom. This construction uses neither diagonal nor cocycle identities.

Choose a cover member through each point of X. Restriction of coherent families to the resulting point-indexed subcover is injective: overlap isomorphisms recover restrictions on intersections with every original member, and separation recovers that component. The equalizer is consequently small in max u v. Shrink this explicit equalizer and transport restrictions and module structure. On the empty space it is the zero module.

Define πi on W ≤ U i by evaluating the i-component. A family on all subopens is determined by the elements on V ∩ U i; conversely restricting those elements produces the family. These operations identify the constructed sections with coherent families and give injectivity and surjectivity of evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem module_compatible_family_sheaf
    (X : RingedSpace.{u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
    (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (Fi : ∀ i : I, SheafOfModules.{max u v} ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
    (φij : ∀ i j : I,
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj (Fi i) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
        (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj (Fi j))
    : ∃ (H : SheafOfModules.{max u v} (moduleRings X))
      (π : ∀ i : I, H.over (U i) ⟶ Fi i),
      ∀ V : Opens X,
        (∀ s : H.val.obj (op V),
          OpenModuleFamilyCoherent X I U Fi φij V
            (openModuleFamilyEval X I U Fi H π V s)) ∧
        Function.Injective (openModuleFamilyEval X I U Fi H π V) ∧
        (∀ a : OpenModuleFamily X I U Fi V,
          OpenModuleFamilyCoherent X I U Fi φij V a →
            ∃ s : H.val.obj (op V), openModuleFamilyEval X I U Fi H π V s = a)
